privileged_info_for_vlm: The process is a Pilot-Scale Methyl Acrylate Synthesis. The 5 chemicals are Acrylic Acid (79-10-7), Sulfuric Acid (7664-93-9), Methanol (67-56-1), Sodium Hydroxide (1310-73-2), and Toluene (108-88-3). A critical hazard is the interaction between Acrylic Acid and Sodium Hydroxide (Step 5), which causes violent exothermic polymerization. Another critical hazard is Methanol and Sulfuric Acid which can react violently. The final report must be at ~/Documents/process_hazard_report.txt.
